# aoss_hostname (Resource)

Manages the switch hostname.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aoss_hostname" "this" {
  hostname = "idf02"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) The hostname to configure on the switch.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
